ats_platforms.notes: Live public RSS feeds verified on 10 November 2026. Root Platform returned 3 items; Footasylum returned 80; TeamViewer returned the default first 100 and a separate offset=100&per_page=2 request returned later vacancies. The total number of TeamViewer vacancies was not established.

ats_platforms.notes: No single general unauthenticated endpoint established for all tenants. Career Site Builder configuration and tenant-specific integrations matter. SAP's legacy RSS/XML career-site response is deprecated: end of development 14 November 2025 and deletion scheduled 14 May 2027. Do not build a new adapter around the retiring feed. Investigate after Workable and Workday. Use Crawlee HTTP-first against each employer's current official public careers site; inspect redirects, sitemaps, JobPosting structured data, embedded payloads and publicly accessible network requests. Use bounded Playwright only when evidence requires it and access is permitted. Keep employer-specific retrieval profiles; generalise a reusable adapter only if a common stable permitted pattern is demonstrated. Do not use the retiring legacy RSS/XML response.

tester_instructions.objective: Investigate actual career pages using browser network inspection, page source/scripts/embedded data, endpoint reproduction and live validation. Do not merely ask an AI to list vacancies.
per_employer: Official career URL and redirect chain
Listing endpoint, method, headers and payload
Individual detail retrieval and full description
Canonical vacancy URL and vacancy-specific application URL
Authentication, bot protection, rate limits or restrictions
tester_instructions.acceptance: HTTP 200 alone is not success. Demonstrate meaningful listing and detail retrieval and preserve the exact vacancy/application destination.
scope_limits: Research and proof of concept only; do not modify application code.
Do not implement adapters until retrieval methods are demonstrated and documented.
Do not bypass authentication, CAPTCHA, bot protection or other access controls.
Test at least three employer boards per ATS where possible; do not generalise from one employer.
